long_zones.label: support sweep or support reaction zone

short_zones.label: nearby liquidation and prior-high rejection zone

no_trade_conditions: price remains near 64000 without reaching support or resistance
value area high is too close to entry and reward-to-risk is poor
breakout through resistance occurs without clear rejection
news-driven move creates volatility without reclaim or rejection confirmation
notes: Transcript favors waiting for price to reach a defined zone. Shorts are preferred on rejection at 65700-67500 or 68500-70000; longs are only tactical if price first trades into 60000-62400 and reacts/reclaims.
